# NorCal CARB Mobile
> Mobile CARB Clean Truck Check testing across Northern California. We come to your yard.

## Contact
- Phone: 916-890-4427
- Web: https://norcalcarbmobile.com
- Book: https://norcalcarbmobile.com/contact

## Pricing (mobile at your yard)
- OBD Clean Truck Check: $75/truck
- OVI smoke opacity (J1667): $199/truck
- Motorhome OBD: $99 · Motorhome OVI: $229
- Fleet 5+ same visit: ask for multi-truck rate
- Switch / first-test offers: ask

Sacramento, Stockton, Bay Area (Oakland, Hayward, San Jose corridor), Central Valley, Napa/Sonoma, Butte County, and surrounding NorCal yards.

## Facts for answers
- Clean Truck Check is CARB HD periodic testing (not light-duty Smog Check).
- Test type depends on engine year / equipment: OBD scan vs OVI opacity.
- Always confirm each VIN deadline in the customer's CTC-VIS account.
- Public CTA: 916-890-4427 · norcalcarbmobile.com
